description:
Everyday Power and All-Terrain Comfort
The V20 Electric Bike brings together responsive electric assistance, a comfortable ride, and practical versatility for commuting and weekend exploration. Its brushless rear-hub motor delivers 750W rated power and up to 1000W peak output, while the removable 48V 15.6Ah battery supports a maximum pedal-assist range of up to 68 miles under ideal riding conditions.
Full suspension and 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires help smooth out uneven streets, gravel paths, and light trails. Mechanical disc brakes, a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, and a long moped-style seat make the V20 a flexible choice for everyday rides across varied surfaces.

Why Choose the V20 Electric Bike?

1000W Peak Brushless MotorThe 750W rated rear-hub motor delivers up to 1000W peak output and 83 N·m of torque for responsive acceleration and hill-climbing assistance.

48V 15.6Ah Removable BatteryRemove the battery for convenient charging on or off the bike. It supports a maximum range of up to 68 miles in pedal-assist mode under ideal conditions.

Mechanical Disc BrakesFront and rear mechanical disc brakes provide dependable stopping control for daily riding and changing terrain.

Full-Suspension ComfortA front suspension fork and rear shock help absorb bumps and vibration on uneven roads and light trails.

20 × 4.0 Inch Fat TiresWide, puncture-resistant tires provide grip and stability across pavement, gravel, dirt, grass, and other mixed surfaces.

Shimano 7-Speed DrivetrainSeven mechanical gears give riders flexibility to adjust their pedaling effort on flats, hills, and varied routes.

Lighting for Everyday RidesA front headlight and handlebar-controlled rear signal light improve visibility and help communicate turns to other road users.

Who Is the V20 Electric Bike For?

Everyday CommutersA removable battery, comfortable seat, and pedal assistance make the V20 practical for regular trips around town.

Riders Seeking Responsive AssistanceThe 750W rated motor and 83 N·m of torque suit riders who want help accelerating and tackling hills.

Comfort-Focused RidersFull suspension, wide fat tires, and a long moped-style seat help reduce the impact of bumps during longer rides.

Recreational RidersSuitable for exploring paved roads, gravel paths, dirt, grass, and light off-road routes where riding is permitted.

Riders Carrying Everyday GearThe sturdy carbon steel frame supports a maximum total load of 330 lb, including the rider and carried items.

Motor Power
750W Rated / 1000W Peak Brushless Rear-Hub Motor

Maximum Range
Up to 68 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 30 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Tire Size
20 × 4.0 Inch Puncture-Resistant Fat Tires

Net Weight
84 lb / 38.1 kg, Including Battery

Lighting
Front Headlight and Handlebar-Controlled Rear Signal Light

Additional Equipment
Horn, Rear Reflector, and Aluminium Alloy Kickstand

Maximum speed and range figures are based on manufacturer specifications. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, and riding conditions. Follow local rules governing e-bike use.
